reguloj.name: contrast-pairs-declared
reguloj.statement: Every combination of a foreground or border color token with the background color token it is placed on has a KontrastParo.
reguloj.kialo: Contrast must be provable per combination (Art. X): the Alirebleco check only evaluates declared KontrastParoj across all resolutions, so an undeclared text-on-background or border-on-background pairing is an unchecked accessibility risk.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens with role foreground, background or border

reguloj.name: semantic-colors-alias-palette
reguloj.statement: Semantic color tokens in core reference palette tokens instead of literal color values.
reguloj.kialo: Aspektoj and Dimensioj then change a color by overriding one palette token, and late binding carries the change to every semantic use in every combination; a literal in a semantic token would silently opt out of that and drift between combinations.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: core color tokens outside color.palette
